text.zh: 中外之官，常明者百有二十四，可名者三百二十，為星二千五百
text.en: Of inner and outer offices, those always bright are 124; nameable ones 320; stars 2,500

outcome.zh: 三垣二十八宿，共一千四百六十七星

translationRepairs: Saturn appears egg-shaped; older observers spoke of "ears," but telescopes show a narrow ring edge-on near the equatorial stars and a broad ring when seen obliquely.
Saturn appears egg-shaped; older observers spoke of "ears," but new measures find the disk very narrow near the equator and very wide far from the equator.

s0007 says 今測近於赤道星面相逼甚窄，於遠赤道所宕甚寬: 星面 is Saturn's disk face near the equator, not equatorial stars, and 今測 is new measures, not telescopes or an edge-on/oblique ring gloss. The proposed idiomatic restores that sense without inventing ring geometry.
Saturn's body is egg-shaped; old measures said two ears at its sides; new measures find the disk near the equatorial stars very narrow and the disk far from the equator very wide.
Saturn's body is egg-shaped; old measures said two ears at its sides; new measures find the disk near the equator very narrow and far from the equator very wide.
The same clause 近於赤道星面 is 赤道 + 星面 (disk near the equator), not 赤道星. The prior literal's 'equatorial stars' is a false parse; the proposed literal matches the Chinese.
Cold Dew—dusk: Northern Dipper, 53′ west of the meridian.
Cold Dew—dusk: Ox, 53′ west of the meridian.
s0161 has 寒露昏牽牛中; 牽牛 is the Ox lodge. Northern Dipper would be 北斗, absent here; 'Ox' is the correct lodge name.
Cold Dew—dusk: Northern Dipper on the meridian, 53′ west of center.
Cold Dew—dusk: Ox on the meridian, 53′ west of center.
Literal English likewise renders 牽牛 as Northern Dipper; the Chinese names the Ox lodge culminating at Cold Dew dusk. 'Ox on the meridian' is accurate.
Clear Bright—dusk: Seven Culminating Stars, 5° 14′ east of the meridian.
Clear Bright—dusk: Seven Stars, 5° 14′ east of the meridian.

Neighboring dusk lines use lodge + 中 (東井中, and dawn 房中 / 帝座中). 七中星 is the same formula with 中 and 星 transposed for the lodge 七星, not a distinct 'Seven Culminating Stars' asterism; 'Seven Stars' matches that reading.
Clear Bright—dusk: Seven Culminating Stars on the meridian, 5° 14′ east of center.
Clear Bright—dusk: Seven Stars on the meridian, 5° 14′ east of center.
The literal should name the lodge 七星 under the same dusk-culmination pattern, not treat 七中星 as a separate asterism title. 'Seven Stars on the meridian' is the correct literal.
